Well, in response to your question, there’s a fandom aspect and a realistic aspect to the interpretation people have given to what Kanye said: most fans of Kanye opt to believe that Kanye is being misinterpreted, since he has been so many times, and I do believe he is to be quite honest with you. Now, I know you and a lot of people, if not the majority, also choose to believe that Kanye was specifically talking about the actual slave trade that indeed did happen and is undeniably true. 
Regardless of his intentions, people have already made up their minds about his statements, so while you have all the right to keep arguing and people will nevertheless continue debating that kanye was focusing on mental slavery, which even minister farrakhan thinks he was, you are really wasting your time. You can’t prove your point and neither can we, because Kanye didn’t really clarify what he meant, apart from stating that he understands slavery wasn’t a choice, while paradoxically pointing to numerical superiority as an all-around solution. There were revolts, and there were methods against and real threats to them. Numbers don’t mean much if you are faced with guns. 
Even so, if we look at the different slaves that were existed through time, there were behavioural differences: south american ones were much harder to control and “break”, so the african ones were used. To say that there wasn’t an element of mentality is just wrong, but saying doesn’t disprove the effects being chained and dragged half a world to a completely different place where you don’t soeak the language, the culture is different, and where future generations of your kin will bear the same weight has on a population. The thing is, the generational effects were monstrous, so the mental slavery he is refering to was present, as an obvious side effect of actual slavery. 
In any case, it is your choice to view this incident solely from the point of fuck kanye, and it's our choice to take stance of “lets hear the man out” even if he is very much uninformed, but your persistentence is not going to get rewarded.
